{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove non-numeric characters and convert to float
# We see that values are like '185.30', so we strip any non-numeric except decimal point
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(r'[^0-9.]', '', regex=True)
sales_df['revenue_clean'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
print(sales_df['revenue_clean'].isna().sum())

# Verify a few cleaned values
print(sales_df[['revenue', 'revenue_clean']].head(10))"}
